ICE Shooting Sparks Political Clash Over Sanctuary City Policies

Following a shooting involving an Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officer in New York City, a political clash has erupted over sanctuary city policies. Representative Markwayne Mullin criticized these policies in the aftermath of the incident. The Trump administration is reportedly facing a legal battle concerning the custody of a suspected gang member following the shooting. Body camera footage showing the moments police arrived on the scene has been analyzed. Additionally, a two-hour phone call between President Trump and ICE official Mamdani after the shooting has been reported.
